name: Drippy Date
source:
In this horror-comedy visual novel, you play as a well-respected food critic whose job is to spend the afternoon at a French restaurant and hopefully get through the three-course meal without incident. To your dismay (or delight?), the restaurant's designated soup chef Spinaché seems very VERY interested in your opinions. 

...wait, is that a green hair in your soup? Hopefully it won't get any worse than this.

[From [url=https://marsa-thing.itch.io/drippy-date]itch.io[/url]]
